proposals.rationale: empty event that exactly fits incoming qty 2; release alone is no-op but concurrent DELETE WHERE holder=jack can remove the just-inserted row while reserved counter still incremented, exposing insert-vs-delete phantom and reserved-vs-sum divergence.

one existing jack reservation with exactly enough space left for qty 2; reserve read-modify-write on reserved races with release decrement of same counter, exposing lost update and delete of new row vs old row mismatch.

full event with split holders jack 1 plus amy 2; reserve must reject unless release frees space first, exposing check-then-act overbooking and stale seats_available in rejections under interleaved read of capacity/reserved.

multiple rows for same holder jack 3 plus jack 2 plus bob 2; release must aggregate both jack rows while reserve concurrently inserts a third jack row, exposing non-atomic select-then-delete and lost update on reserved counter.
